 📢 Corporation Tax Filing Deadline Extended! 📢

The Barbados Revenue Authority (BRA) has extended the deadline for filing Corporation Tax returns for the Income Year 2024.

🔹 New Deadlines: ✅ April 17, 2025 – For fiscal periods ending January 1 – September 30 ✅ June 15, 2025 – For fiscal periods ending October 1 – December 31

For full details, download the official Guidance Note here.

For assistance, contact the BRA Contact Centre at 1(246) 429-ETAX or 429-3829.
